name: PopCash Advertise Tool
author: PopCash

sections.description:
PopCash Advertise Tool integrates your WordPress site directly with the PopCash.net API to automatically create advertising campaigns every time you publish a new article.

How It Works

  1. Connect your PopCash account using your API key, configure your campaign defaults once, and the plugin takes care of the rest.
  2. Every time you publish a new article, a PopCash campaign is automatically created to drive traffic to that post, no manual steps, no switching between platforms.

Features

  • Automated Campaign Creation — New article published? A PopCash campaign launches automatically. Save time and never miss a promotion opportunity.
  • Full Campaign Setup from WordPress — Set your bid, targeting options (geo, device, OS), budget, and scheduling directly from WP-Admin.
  • Full Targeting Control — configure countries, devices, operating systems, languages, and browsers
  • Simple API Connection — All you need is your PopCash API key. Setup takes under 2 minutes.
  • Campaign Monitoring — Track campaigns, from a single dashboard inside WordPress.
  • Traffic-Based Scheduling — Schedule ad delivery to match your site’s peak traffic hours for maximum ROI.

External Services

This plugin connects to the PopCash.net API to create and manage advertising campaigns on your behalf.

What data is sent and when:
* Your PopCash API key is sent with every API request for authentication
* When you publish a new article, the plugin sends campaign data including: article URL, title, targeting preferences (countries, devices, operating systems, browsers, languages), budget settings, and scheduling preferences
* The plugin retrieves targeting options (available countries, devices, OS, etc.) from the API to populate dropdown menus in settings

Service provider:
* Service: PopCash.net API (https://api.popcash.net)
* Terms of Service: https://popcash.net/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://popcash.net/privacy

When is the service used:
* When you click “Test Connection” or “Connect” in plugin settings
* Automatically when you publish a new WordPress post (if plugin is enabled)
* When you refresh targeting options from the settings page
* When viewing the Campaign Monitor page

Account requirement:
* You must have a PopCash advertiser account and API key to use this plugin
* Sign up at: https://popcash.net/

  • Fixed: Renamed main class from PopCash_GDiscovery to PCADTO_Main

  • Added: Contributors list updated

1.4.0

  • Initial release
  • PopCash API integration for campaign creation
  • Targeting options: countries, devices, OS, languages, browsers
  • Campaign log page
  • Post edit screen meta box
